items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: we all got together and made a little seven piece band

ctx.x: Oh, how old were you then? And, uh. Who? How old were you then?

Who? Me? Yeah. About that time? Oh, I guess I was around about twenty-twenty-one or something like that. And, uh, well, otherwise we come as to learn that I'd play a couple of numbers like that and we picked up on little John Casney. Mm-hmm.
